Claim or Limitation: Lead time is calculated as Ship Date minus Order Date. It is not independently verified carrier transit time.
Product-to-factory mapping is a reference mapping, not verified historical dispatch.
The model uses 20 predictor features. Factory is not included as a model predictor.
Haversine distances represent straight-line distance, not road or freight-route distance.
Alternative factory freight or manufacturing cost savings have not been independently established.
Scenario support is not a probability of success.
Recommendations are indicative and are not proven to be globally optimal.
Existing model metric discrepancies must remain documented and must not be silently reconciled.
